title: KGCS Offensive Agent Response Data
description: Schema for the 'data' field in Offensive Agent responses. Covers Weakness → AttackPattern → Technique → Tactic traversals. Placed inside the canonical response envelope (agent-consumable-schema.json). Causal invariant: Weakness must traverse AttackPattern before reaching Technique — no shortcuts.

techniques.description: ATT&CK techniques reachable via the full causal chain from the queried Weakness. Empty when no path exists.

tactic.description: Primary tactic phase name (phaseName from Tactic node).

tactics.description: All tactic phases this technique belongs to (techniques can appear in multiple tactics).

capec.description: CAPEC attack patterns that implement this technique (IMPLEMENTS edges, sourced from CAPEC XML Taxonomy_Mapping).

subtechniques.description: Child SubTechnique IDs (SUBTECHNIQUE_OF edges, reverse direction). Only present for Technique nodes, not for SubTechnique nodes.

parent_technique.description: Parent technique ID. Only present when 'id' is a SubTechnique (T####.###).

attack_paths.description: Full causal paths from the queried Weakness to each Technique. Paths may use a direct CAPEC→ATT&CK mapping or an inherited mapping via one or more parent CAPEC nodes.

attack_pattern_id.description: Intermediate CAPEC attack pattern (causal chain hop; must not be skipped).

mapping_type.description: Whether the ATT&CK mapping is attached directly to the queried CAPEC or inherited through a parent CAPEC.

mapped_attack_pattern_id.description: Parent CAPEC that directly carries the ATT&CK mapping when mapping_type is inherited.

hierarchy_depth.description: Number of CAPEC ChildOf hops from attack_pattern_id to mapped_attack_pattern_id.
